title: Chord bound for the exponential on the unit interval
statement:
For every $\eta > 0$ and every $x \in [0,1]$, the value $e^{-\eta x}$ lies below the chord joining the endpoints of the graph of $t \mapsto e^{-\eta t}$ over $[0,1]$; that is, the inequality
\[
  e^{-\eta x} \;\le\; 1 - \bigl(1 - e^{-\eta}\bigr)\,x
\]
holds, the right-hand side being the affine function equal to $1$ at $x = 0$ and to $e^{-\eta}$ at $x = 1$.
